summary: Merged from two critics (17 cards each). Half A: The round-2 blocker is resolved. Haste is now a split-second problem (catching a toppling crockery stall's jars) with options that share nothing with Tailwind's long road. The non-blocking notes on Ward, Purify and Flame are applied cleanly. All 17 cards follow the user's rule: the spell appears only as up[spell], nothing assumes you know it, and each up showcases its spell's desc. Half B: Every round-1 issue is fixed. Brask is she/her; torment's later showings are other opponents and none assumes an earlier outcome; moonwell's up costs a cold night that every say shows and no longer gives Mana it pours away; extraction leaves you nearly dry, so the cast is possible; reflect's graze shows in every variant; and the header gives 3 against 120. The user's rule still holds on all 17 cards, and lint has 0 errors. One leftover piece of polish, below.

issues.problem: Polish, not blocking. Text variant 2 is fixed ("along a new seam"), but the up's step 3 ("The baker names it after you, and kicks it when it sticks") still leaves a machine at the oven, while every later showing opens on a cold oven waiting on split bellows.
issues.fix: Make the machine short-lived, for example "…The baker names it after you, and it shakes itself to bits by the last batch."
